# What the preview publishes, one path per line, relative to the repo root.
#
# Not the whole repository: GitHub Pages serves at most 1GB per site and the
# tree here is over 3GB — the home pages carry ~150MB of assets each. So a
# preview names the pages the current work is about, and stays small enough
# that every branch's preview can sit alongside the others.
#
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

# This branch is the design-system pass over every page. Two pages go up from
# it, the two that are in front of the client:
#
#   the search prototype — the glass, the full-screen phone mode, the header
#   the home page        — the vessel and event cards, the bento, the footer
#
# The chat page, pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - Home Page (Crisp Chat), stood in the
# second slot until the home page itself went in front of the client. It is one
# line away from coming back, but only one of the two fits: they are ~95 and
# ~150MB and the site is already at 829MB of the 900 the guard below allows.
pages/jby-search
pages/Jeff Brown Yachts - Home Page
